queries.result: Search found no verified Xinji-specific public cadastral viewer or anonymous parcel API. The official Xinji government home page was then fetched directly.

registryBasis: Official Xinji government pages identify the local Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and real-estate registration center as custodians for land and real-estate registration procedures. This establishes a local administrative custodian, not an open parcel-data service.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official Xinji government homepage loaded. HTML navigation/search evidence identified Natural Resources Bureau and real-estate-registration policy links, but no cadastral viewer or parcel API configuration was found in the fetched page.

Official Xinji service article states that real-estate transfer procedures involve the real-estate registration center and government service platform; it provides no public parcel geometry or map endpoint.
Official policy identifies the Xinji Natural Resources and Planning Bureau's role in land-use review and real-estate registration, but does not expose an anonymous public cadastral service.
